## Current State

The current evidence packet is a pilot calibration record. It helps test
provenance, segmentation, observation review, negative evidence, and rival
explanation workflow. It does not release a finding or promote a claim.

## Promotion Boundary

A future claim page should appear only after a canonical claim record links to
supporting, contradicting, and qualifying evidence, and after the project has
recorded the required review state.
